speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the infant have a history of maternal diabetes or perinatal asphyxia, and are they currently requiring supplemental oxygen or mechanical ventilation? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest_Radiograph: Fine reticular granulation with ground glass appearance on both lungs

speaker: Doctor
text: The chest X-ray findings of fine reticular granulation and ground-glass appearance are classic for Respiratory Distress Syndrome in a premature infant. DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (Hyaline Membrane Disease)
